claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if photonics orders stop recurring in Aehr filings (10-K segment/backlog) or the unnamed customers are revealed to be non-CPO applications; upgrade only when a customer is named or a teardown/filing ties FOX-XP capacity to a specific CPO program.
claims.statement: Aehr Test Systems supplies wafer-level burn-in/stabilization systems (FOX-XP) for silicon photonics ICs targeting the hyperscale datacenter optical interconnect market, with a lead customer in production and follow-on orders plus a second major customer win — per Aehr's own announcements. Scope honesty: wafer-level burn-in is one stage of the CPO test stack, not full-stack module-level test; customers are unnamed (supplier self-report, L8), so which CPO program consumes this capacity is unverified.
